name: AI Blog Research & Publishing Pipeline - Portfolio Demo

options.systemMessage: You are a research planner. Generate natural search queries, not keyword-stuffed strings. Prefer queries that can surface credible, current evidence.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ api_key: $env.TAVILY_API_KEY, query: $json.query, search_depth: 'advanced', max_results: 5, include_answer: false, include_raw_content: false }) }}

options.systemMessage: You are a content strategist working from supplied research evidence. Strong business relevance and evidence quality matter more than catchy titles.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ api_key: $env.TAVILY_API_KEY, query: $json.selected_topic.title + ' ' + $json.selected_topic.angle + ' ' + $json.business_summary, search_depth: 'advanced', max_results: 8, include_answer: false, include_raw_content: false }) }}
